statements.text: A. Herique, Y. Rogez, M. Roudaud, W. Kofman, ROSETTA-ORBITER/ROSETTA-LANDER 67P CONSERT 4 FSS V1.0, RO/RL-C-CONSERT-4-FSS-V1.0, ESA Planetary Science Archive and NASA Planetary Data System, 2019.
statements.scope: Every CONSERT level-4 First Science Sequence input.
statements.evidence: Dataset citation in catalog/dataset.cat of the archived volume.

statements.text: No licence is asserted. The archive asks that the instrument team and the archive be acknowledged.

The GEOMETRY tables are in the Comet Fixed Frame. The SC_TARGET_POSITION_VECTOR and SC_SUN_POSITION_VECTOR keywords in the product labels are a different frame, and the level-2 ERRATA.TXT states the label geometry keywords must not be used.
statements.evidence: catalog/dataset.cat, Coordinate System: 'The geometric data, composed of Rosetta and Philae position, velocity and attitude, are provided in the Comet Fixed Frame coordinate system.'

statements.text: The archived Philae position is the one known at delivery and is not revised when the localisation improves. Kofman et al. (2020, MNRAS 497, 2616) work from a position about 13 m from the archived value.
statements.scope: The lander end of every retained sounding path.
statements.evidence: https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/staa2001 and document/ro-ocn-tn-3870.pdf, the CONSERT Archive User Guide.
